subject: Hosted API evaluation — demo scheduling (BrightLayer)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@brightlayer.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API eval request

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for a Hosted API evaluation via your site and landed at BrightLayer's evaluation workspace earlier today — thanks for making the self-serve so easy. We're hoping to get a quick 30-minute demo next week to see how Redwood's Hosted API would fit into our roadmap.

We're on PST. My preferred time would be Wed 12/09 around 10:00 AM PST, but we can be flexible. Quick context: we're focused on low-latency real-time generation (customer chat) and cost per token is a big factor.

Happy to share a short agenda — main ask is to see latency/cost tradeoffs and a sketch of a rollout plan.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform
BrightLayer

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@brightlayer.io>
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request

Thanks Jordan — great to meet you (virtually)! I'm Marissa on the outbound SDR team and I can get you on the calendar. Alex (cc'd) will run the product/technical demo.

Concretely: would either of these work for a 30-minute session?
- Wed 2026-12-09 10:00 AM PST (your first pick)
- Thu 2026-12-10 11:00 AM PST

If neither, send over 2-3 times that work and we'll take it. I'll also attach a short demo deck and a starter pricing sheet so you have context ahead of time.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m intros & goals
- 15m demo: Hosted API (latency/cost controls, routing options)
- 5m Q&A on security/compliance and dedicated options
- 5m next steps (trial configuration / follow-up evaluation items)

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm a slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Outbound SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: BrightLayer-demo-deck.pdf, redwood-hosted-pricing-sheet.xlsx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@brightlayer.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-05T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply and the agenda. Wed at 10am conflicts with a product review that slid; Thu 12/10 at 11:00 AM PST would work for me.

A couple of prep items for the demo team:
- Can you include any notes on typical per-token latency for short chat turns (seq len ~50) on Hosted API?
- We're interested in whether Redwood's runtime supports KV cache reuse across sessions and any batching guidance for chat workloads.

If Alex can cover the technical parts that'd be great. Looking forward to the invite.

- Jordan

On Sat, Dec 5, 2026 at 10:05 AM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Thanks Jordan — great to meet you (virtually)! I'm Marissa on the outbound SDR team...
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@brightlayer.io>
Cc: alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-06T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval request — confirmed 12/10 11:00 AM PST

Perfect — confirmed for Thu, 2026-12-10 11:00 AM PST (30 minutes). Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-brightlayer-demo

Alex will lead the demo and cover latency numbers, KV caching behavior, batching recommendations, and a short sketch for a rollout plan aligned to your chat workload.

I've attached the deck and pricing sheet again for Alex to annotate. Quick replies to your prep items:
- Latency: for short chat turns (seq len ~50) we typically see median p95 token latency in the 40–90ms range on Hosted API depending on model choice; we'll show specific benchmark snippets during the demo.
- KV cache: yes, runtime supports KV caching & reuse; we'll demo prefix caching strategies and options for session affinity.
- Batching: we'll outline when to favor continuous batching vs per-request low-latency paths.

Next steps after the demo: share a short eval checklist (prompts/traffic profile), optional trial credits if you want to load test, and a follow-up technical deep dive if needed.

Thanks — speak Thu.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Outbound SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: BrightLayer-demo-deck.pdf, redwood-hosted-pricing-sheet.xlsx
